title: Ciphertext CT-perturbation planning lane
rationale: The registered KryptosBot findings source documents a CT-perturbation or symbol-swap anomaly as an unresolved structural question, not as plaintext, key material, a route, or a solution claim. This lane fixes the C/T ciphertext-position surface before any future source-backed observation scoring. It is not another public-anchor mining pass because it uses a source-documented ciphertext-local symbol set, excludes public known-plaintext positions from the target positions, and does not use additive fragment values, candidate words, routes, or prior source-backed observation scores for discovery.
prediction_target: Future independently source-backed non-anchor K4 position observations may be checked for enrichment in predeclared C/T ciphertext positions only after a family-specific evaluator and null controls are implemented; this artifact alone is not evidence.
discovery_inputs: Registered methodology-context source kryptosbot-findings-2026 for the bounded CT-perturbation or symbol-swap surface
evaluation_inputs: A future family-specific observation validator and evaluator for the committed CT-perturbation artifact
Future source-backed non-anchor position observations selected before any CT-perturbation score output
Observation files whose scored positions were not used to construct or tune the CT-perturbation artifact
controls: family-specific validator and evaluator required before scoring
known solved-position intervals are excluded from target positions and never used as scoring evidence
same-size non-anchor position-shuffle null required before interpreting any source-backed hit count
ciphertext-symbol shuffle preserving K4 length and C/T target-symbol count required before interpreting the C/T surface itself
multiple-comparison correction required before interpreting any CT-perturbation score
no promotion from this planning artifact alone
